Sundar starts from point P, which is 29 km to the east of Point A, and drives 9 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 13 km and stops at Point Q. What is the shortest distance between Point Q and Point B? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)

S lives on an even numbered floor but not 4. The sum of floors on which S and T live is 9. Only 3 people live between P and U. The sum of floors on which Q and U live is 3. How many people live below P?

In this question, a statement is given, followed by two courses of action numbered 1 and 2. Assuming everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:Villagers are migrating to urban areas to support their families and their livelihood.Courses of Action:1. Only urban areas can provide them jobs for livelihood.2. Villagers should be guided to explore alternative resources to sustain their livelihood.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only action 2 follows) है।

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing the north. A sits third to the right of B. Only two people sit between A and C. E sits third to the left of D. Only one person sits between D and C. E is not an immediate neighbour of B. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated?3268

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1, I, N, F and O are seated and all of them are facing the south.In row 2, J, A, R and S are seated and all of them are facing the north.Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.N sits third to the right of O. S sits third to the left of R. F sits at some place to the right of I and is not facing A. The one facing I is an immediate neighbour of R. Which of the following options represents both people sitting at extreme ends of the line?3021
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (O and R) है।

questions.question: Laxman started driving from point A and drove 5 km towards the north. Then he took a left turn and drove 10 km. He again took a left turn and drove 4 km and reached point B. Priya started driving from point A and drove 5 km towards the north. She took a right turn and drove another 5 km. She took another right turn and drove 4 km and reached point C. In which direction is point B with respect to point C? (All turns are 90 degree turns.)

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Q has an exam immediately before P. S has an exam immediately after T. Only five people have an exam between T and P. V has an exam on one of the days before R but on one of the days after U. Who has an exam on Friday?3252

In a certain code language,‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,‘A − B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’ and‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.Which of the following means that K is the brother of L?(I) K − L $ J + M % N(II) L $ K + J % N − M(III) K − M $ N + J % L(IV) J − K $ M + L % N 3073

Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement.Statement: A prominent software giant, Company T, reported a 30% increase in employee productivity following the implementation of a mandatory four-day work week and the introduction of wellness programs. The CEO expressed that employees felt more revitalised and motivated.Conclusions:(I) Employee well-being can positively impact productivity in company T.(II) A 4-day work week is the sole reason for increased productivity in the company T.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion I follows.) है।
